newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bolsa seen keeping guarded tone.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bolsa seen keeping guarded tone.

text.p: Argentine stocks were expected to drift aimlessly lower at the opening Tuesday as investors continue to stay put ahead of the release of U.S. inflation data Wednesday and Thursday, dealers said.

"The market will remain cautious until it learns the inflation figures, and then if these numbers don't tilt the scale in favor or against a Federal Reserve rate hike on May 20, it will probably just keep shifting sideways with scant volume," said Miguel Daneri at traders Boston Securities.
The blue-chip MerVal index edged up 0.4 percent Monday to 726.96 in thin turnover of 16.3 million pesos.
"It's a dull patch, but there is a sense that there's a trend just waiting to happen because this limbo in the markets has already lasted almost two months," another trader said.
